Fake war heroes must face justice
2014-11-10T00:00:00+06:00 | Shahjahan Hafiz, Gulshan, Dhaka
https://www.thedailystar.net/fake-war-heroes-must-face-justice-49507

I have come to know from TDS that two secretaries who forged freedom fighters' certificates to extend the tenure of their job have resigned from their job recently. They should have quit the day the ACC submitted its findings and asked the government to take action against them. But they stuck to their chairs shamelessly without even thinking that their subordinates had lost all respect for them. It is further reported that they resigned after the government ordered them to do so. My question is, is that the end? Haven't they committed a crime? Shouldn't they have been arrested? Are there different laws for the elites and the powerless?
